trajectory_summary: The call moves efficiently through most of the verify sequence on a warm referral lead, with the customer volunteering useful information (bill range, motivation, title structure) with minimal resistance. However, the call ends without a booked appointment, without looping in Zoe (the actual title-owner and credit-qualifier subject), and with the bill collection handled as a same-day text follow-up rather than a locked next step — the energy the customer brought was not converted into a structural commitment.
outcome_dispute: The call closes with 'we'll keep in touch' and a promise to text bill-collection instructions — there is no day/time appointment offered or set. This should not be read as booked or even tentative; it is closer to a callback/no_appointment hybrid, since the only concrete next step is Jacob sending a bill photo, not a scheduled consultant call.
